alerts.title: Gulf Trade With Central Asia Surges as Energy Ties Deepen
alerts.summary: Trade between Central Asia and Gulf states has almost quadrupled between 2020 and 2025 but still accounts for just a tiny percentage of the region’s overall trade turnover. Over a similar timeframe, Gulf investment in Central Asia has grown three-fold, according to a report published by the Eurasian Development Bank.  The EDB’s analytical brief shows the balance of trade tilts heavily in favor of Gulf states, with agricultural products, vehicles, machinery, equipment, pharmaceuticals, precious metals and electronics forming the…
